title: 第十一章 识相！
slug: 分手后觉醒逆天改命系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“我不管你和他有什么过节，他现在正在扫咱们店的货！”

一连串话语响起，杨京把事说了一遍。

杨旭脸色铁青，“大伯，这事怪我，但我会解决，这样，您把电话给他，我和他说。”

杨京走到叶凡面前，“我侄儿想和你聊聊。”

叶凡冷笑，接过电话，“杨总有何指示？莫非还想挖我的眼？”

“哈哈哈…叶兄弟真会开玩笑，昨天的事我听说了，是场误会…”

“误会你妈！”

叶凡眼神一寒，“复合弓和砍刀都拿出来了，你跟我说误会？你他妈当我三岁小孩呢？”

“…好，兄弟骂得对，我承认这是我错，是我眼瞎，不知道兄弟是王虎朋友，我在这先给兄弟道歉…”

“道你妈的歉！”

叶凡再骂，“杨旭，我告诉你，你少说那些废话！你想平这事，只有两个方法，一，滚到我面前，让我亲手废了你！二，把我挑的原石都给我！你选吧！”

杨京沉默。

电话那头的他身体颤抖，脸颊浮现一抹狰狞。

他气疯了。

他是杨家三少，从小到大，谁见他都无比恭敬，哪有敢这么骂他的？

偏偏叶凡骂了，他怎能不怒？

但他清楚，他不能翻脸。

他惹不起王虎！

深吸几口气，杨旭压下情绪，“好，兄弟够直接，我选第二个，麻烦兄弟把手机给我大伯。”

“算你他妈识相！”

叶凡一抛，把手机丢给杨京。

杨京放到耳边，几秒后，他脸色一变，震惊看向叶凡。

最终他道，“好，我知道了。”

说完，他挂断电话，对叶凡道，“我还以为是谁，原来是盛宝楼的叶大师，而盛宝楼和我梦金园本就是合作伙伴，所以没问题，叶大师随便挑，挑完后，我们都会送到盛宝楼。”

叶凡冷冷道，“钱呢？”

"I don't care what disputes you have with him, he is currently scanning the goods in our store!"

A series of words sounded, and Yang Jing explained the matter again.

Yang Xu's face was livid, "Uncle, it's my fault, but I will solve it. In this way, you give him the phone and I will talk to him."

Yang Jing walked up to Ye Fan, "My nephew wants to talk to you."

Ye Fan sneered and took the phone, "What are Mr. Yang's instructions? Do you still want to dig out my eyes?"

"Hahaha...Brother Ye is really good at joking. I heard about what happened yesterday. It was a misunderstanding..."

"I misunderstood your mother!"

Ye Fan's eyes turned cold, "I have taken out the compound bow and machete, and you told me that I have a misunderstanding? Do you think I am a three-year-old child?"

"...Okay, brother is right to scold me. I admit it was my fault. I was blind. I didn't know that brother was Wang Hu's friend. I apologize to brother in advance..."

"Say your mother's apology!"

Ye Fan scolded again, "Yang Xu, let me tell you, stop talking nonsense! You have only two ways to settle this matter. One, get in front of me and let me kill you with my own hands! Two, give me all the rough stones I picked! You choose!"

Yang Jing was silent.

On the other end of the phone, his body trembled, and a ferocious look appeared on his cheeks.

He was furious.

He is the third young master of the Yang family. Ever since he was young, everyone has been extremely respectful to him. How could anyone dare to scold him like this?

But Ye Fan scolded him, how could he not be angry?

But he knew that he couldn't fall out.

He can't afford to offend Wang Hu!

Taking a few deep breaths, Yang Xu suppressed his emotions and said, "Okay, brother, I'm straightforward enough. I'll choose the second one. Please give me your phone to my uncle."

"You're damn wise!"

Ye Fan threw the phone to Yang Jing.

Yang Jing put it to his ear. After a few seconds, his expression changed and he looked at Mark in shock.

Finally he said, "Okay, I get it."

After saying that, he hung up the phone and said to Ye Fan, "Who I thought it was, it turned out to be Master Ye from Shengbao House, and Shengbao House and I, Mengjinyuan, are partners, so it's no problem. Master Ye can pick whatever he wants. After the selection, we will send it to Shengbao House."

Ye Fan said coldly, "Where's the money?"
